properties.label: Aksu
properties.title: Aksu
properties.description: A waypoint on the northern route. An oasis providing critical supplies for westbound merchants.

properties.label: Alak-Mor
properties.title: Alak-Mor
properties.description: Great Colored Depths of the Eastern Highlands

properties.label: The Anvil-Sunder Switchbacks
properties.title: The Anvil-Sunder Switchbacks
properties.description: A punishing alternate high route of tight switchbacks and exposed ridgelines.

properties.label: Balkh-Kamen
properties.title: Balkh-Kamen
properties.description: Stone Mirror of the Central Tarimhighlands

properties.label: Balkh
properties.title: Balkh
properties.description: Once the 'Mother of Cities,' Balkh was destroyed by Genghis Khan and never fully recovered. Now a haunting reminder of past glory.

properties.label: Black-Timber Post
properties.title: Black-Timber Post
properties.description: Fortified overnight station with stables and a small shrine; a safe stop when the weather turns.

properties.label: Bukhara
properties.title: Bukhara
properties.description: Center of Islamic scholarship and trade. A major city of Sogdiana with 140+ architectural monuments.

properties.label: The Buried Lens
properties.title: The Buried Lens
properties.description: A half-excavated relic site where glassy strata and strange echoes suggest buried ancient works.

properties.label: The Caravan-Crypt
properties.title: The Caravan-Crypt
properties.description: A sealed cache-chamber used by merchants in hard times; its entrance is easy to miss without a guide.

properties.label: Chang'an
properties.title: Chang'an
properties.description: The eastern terminus of the Silk Road. An imperial capital with 12-mile walls built in 1370. Where merchants complete their epic journeys.

properties.label: Charklik
properties.title: Charklik
properties.description: A waypoint on the southern route between desert sections.

properties.label: Cherchen
properties.title: Cherchen
properties.description: A waypoint on the southern route between eastern and western Taklamakan sections.

properties.label: Dunhuang
properties.title: Dunhuang
properties.description: Gateway to China; home to the Mogao Caves with thousands of Buddhist artworks spanning centuries.

properties.label: Endere
properties.title: Endere
properties.description: An isolated waypoint on the southern route through harsh desert.

properties.label: Isyk-Zhel
properties.title: Isyk-Zhel
properties.description: Warm Winds of the Mountain Realm

properties.label: Jade Gate
properties.title: Jade Gate
properties.description: The western gateway to imperial China. A heavily fortified checkpoint where all merchants are inspected and taxed.

properties.label: Khotan
properties.title: Khotan
properties.description: The jade capital of the Silk Road. A mountain kingdom that converted from Buddhism to Islam, but jade remains its lifeblood.

properties.label: Kucha
properties.title: Kucha
properties.description: A major Buddhist center with magnificent Kizil Caves nearby. A place of pilgrimage and monastic study.

properties.label: Maralbashi
properties.title: Maralbashi
properties.description: A waypoint at the base of mountain passes. Guides here help merchants navigate the treacherous western mountain crossing.

properties.label: Merv (Mary)
properties.title: Merv (Mary)
properties.description: Once a great oasis city, destroyed by Genghis Khan's son. Now rebuilt as Mary, a smaller settlement.

properties.label: Miran Temple District
properties.title: Miran Temple District
properties.description: Ruined temple compounds and broken statuary beyond Miran's waypoint; haunted by wind and sand.

properties.label: Miran
properties.title: Miran
properties.description: A waypoint on the southern desert route. An ancient settlement with ruins of Buddhist temples.

properties.label: Niya Outer Fields
properties.title: Niya Outer Fields
properties.description: Collapsed irrigation lines and wind-buried walls on the approach to Niya; easy to miss in a sandstorm.

properties.label: Niya
properties.title: Niya
properties.description: Ancient oasis ruins on the southern route. Archaeological treasures hidden in the sands await discovery.

properties.label: Salt-Reed Oasis
properties.title: Salt-Reed Oasis
properties.description: A reliable water stop at the edge of a brutal stretch; reeds and salt flats mark it from afar.

properties.label: Samarqandh
properties.title: Samarqandh
properties.description: A major hub on the Silk Road, known for its bazaars and monumental architecture.

properties.label: The Stone Ledger Gate
properties.title: The Stone Ledger Gate
properties.description: A controlled high pass where weights, measures, and cargo manifests are certified before crossing.

properties.label: Tashkent
properties.title: Tashkent
properties.description: The largest city in Central Asia. Known as the 'Stone City' for its fortifications.

properties.label: Turfan Depression
properties.title: Turfan Depression
properties.description: An oasis in a depression, protected from harsh desert winds. Known for cultivation of grapes and wine production.

properties.label: The Wind-Cut Narrows
properties.title: The Wind-Cut Narrows
properties.description: A canyon pinch-point where the road compresses into a single file—ideal for tolls, patrols, and ambushes.

properties.label: Yarkand
properties.title: Yarkand
properties.description: A major waypoint where the southern and northern routes converge. A hub of trade and communication.

properties.label: Yumen Waystation (Outer)
properties.title: Yumen Waystation (Outer)
properties.description: Overflow staging post for caravans approaching the Jade Gate; paperwork, inspections, and remounts.
